title: main screen fixes e3 through e6

commit.merge_subject: merge: main screen fixes e3 through e6

description:
E5 (owner finding 2026-11-11): the device stacked the Encoded chip's
characters vertically ("En/co/de/d") although the chip row already
scrolls horizontally. The row's horizontalScroll does hand chips
unbounded width (foundation Scroll.kt ScrollingLayoutNode: child
maxWidth = Constraints.Infinity), but the label Text had NO single-line
guard, and M3 ChipContent measures the label with
constraints.offset(horizontal = -(leadingIconWidth + trailingIconWidth))
— the selected chip's check icon subtracts from the label's width — so
a squeezed label fell back to per-character line breaks.
FilterChipsRow now emits the label Text itself with maxLines = 1 +
softWrap = false (+ TextOverflow.Visible), so single-line holds BY
CONSTRUCTION for every caller — including the longest label, Turkish
"Sıkıştırılmış" — and the chip keeps its full intrinsic width (the row
scrolls for overflow instead of ever
changed: fix: settings dims and library header alignment
fix: single-line filter chips and back exits selection
